faq-page.answer1: The number of items of luggage depends on the type of vehicle booked. For standard vehicles, we can carry up to 4 pieces of standard luggage (suitcases) and 4 pieces of hand luggage. If you need to transport 8 or more pieces of luggage, we recommend that you book a larger vehicle or inform us in advance. We will adapt the vehicle to your needs to ensure a comfortable journey.
faq-page.answer2: The number of pieces of luggage depends on the vehicle booked. For standard vehicles, we can carry a maximum of 4 pieces of standard luggage (suitcases) and 4 pieces of hand luggage. If you need to carry 8 or more pieces of luggage, we recommend you book a larger vehicle or notify us in advance. We will adapt the vehicle to your needs to ensure a comfortable journey.
faq-page.answer3:
For your convenience and flexibility, we offer several payment options.

Online payment:
You can pay securely at the time of booking by credit card (Visa, Mastercard, or other accepted cards). Our online payment system is encrypted and guarantees the confidentiality of your data.

Cash payment:
If you prefer, you can pay directly to your driver at the time of transfer. Please provide the exact amount to facilitate the transaction.

We recommend that you choose your payment method at the time of booking to ensure a smooth, surprise-free experience. If you have any questions about payment methods, please contact us at info@brussels-shuttle.be.
faq-page.answer4:
Yes, you can change the date of your transfer by contacting us at least 24 hours before the scheduled time. Simply send us an e-mail to info@brussels-shuttle.be or contact us via our online form. We will do our utmost to adjust your booking to suit your needs, subject to availability.

If you wish to make a change less than 24 hours before the scheduled transfer time, please call us directly on +32 471 010 113. Our teams will do their best to find a rapid solution adapted to your situation.

We recommend that you let us know as soon as possible to ensure that your request is handled in the best possible way.
faq-page.answer5: Yes, you can book a last-minute transfer, subject to availability. For urgent requests, please contact us directly by telephone on +32 471 010 113 so that we can check availability and confirm your booking quickly. We will do our best to accommodate your request.
faq-page.answer6: Yes, we offer child seats for their safety and comfort, subject to availability. Please let us know when you book so that we can check and prepare them in advance.
faq-page.answer7: We monitor flight times in real time. If your flight is delayed, your driver will adjust his arrival time at no extra charge. Please be sure to quote your flight number when booking so that we can track any changes.
